# OPPO Pad Mini OPD2515 research

> Public device-specific findings on Wi-Fi, ColorOS policies, graphics frame pacing, touch, controller input and streaming. Investigation closed; optional buffer helper disabled. Findings are limited to the tested firmware/device. Total input-to-screen latency was not measured.

## Read first

- [Public findings and complete catalog](https://github.com/Mokomis/opd2515-wifi-fix/blob/main/FINDINGS.md)
- [Final recommendations and retained state](https://github.com/Mokomis/opd2515-wifi-fix/blob/main/docs/investigations/2026-10-11/final-recommendations.md)
- [Investigation index](https://github.com/Mokomis/opd2515-wifi-fix/blob/main/docs/investigations/2026-10-11/README.md)
- [Historical independent audit](https://github.com/Mokomis/opd2515-wifi-fix/blob/main/docs/investigations/2026-10-11/independent-audit.md)
- [Machine-readable catalog with raw URLs and checksums](https://github.com/Mokomis/opd2515-wifi-fix/blob/main/findings-index.json)

## Evidence limits

Raw logs, traces, private databases, firmware/APKs and decompiled vendor source are excluded. Local work/ paths and REA IDs are not accessible evidence. Later final recommendations supersede historical current-state claims. No proven end-to-end latency benefit should be inferred from ready-to-present metrics.
